# ACT 3 AI

> ACT 3 AI is an AI filmmaking platform that turns a script into a finished film. It parses a script into beats, scenes, and shots; holds characters consistent with per-character identity models, wardrobe, and voice; generates cinematography, first frames, prompts, lipsync, and motion capture; and assembles the whole runtime onto one timeline you can watch end to end. It is built for full-length work -- features, TV episodes, and marketing video at volume -- rather than for single short clips.

Everything below is a public page on https://act3ai.com. The articles are evergreen reference pages, not dated posts.

## Product

- [Home](https://act3ai.com/): what the platform is and who it is for.
- [Features](https://act3ai.com/features): the capability list.
- [Assistant Director Team](https://act3ai.com/level2): a dedicated team that produces your films inside ACT 3 AI.
- [MCP server](https://act3ai.com/mcp): drive ACT 3 AI from Claude Code.
- [CLI](https://act3ai.com/cli): the command line interface.
- [Pricing](https://app.act3ai.com/settings/plans/): plans and credits.
- [About](https://act3ai.com/about) / [Contact](https://act3ai.com/contact)
